title.narrative: OECD - Clean Energy Finance and Investment Mobilisation Programme - phase 2, Mid-Term Review (MTR)

description.narrative: Danida procedures require a mandatory Mid-Term Review (MTR) of the Project. The MTR could include assembling evidence that builds on the results framework to provide an assessment on the extent to which there has been a contribution to the higher-level outcomes that are beyond the measurement scope of the routine monitoring and indicators provided by the results framework itself. The Mid-Term Review of the Project shall be planned in advance and carried out in a spirit of collaboration between the Danish MoFA and the OECD. The practical arrangements for the review, including its timing and modalities, shall be discussed with the OECD to ensure alignment and a smooth process. The Mid-Term Review shall not constitute any audit. OECD should not be asked to provide additional financial documentation within the scope of this MTR such as invoices, receipts, copies of contracts with contractors etc.
